text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Fufufu...!
Ah... How wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Running true to one's pure nature.
How breathtakingly beautiful it is...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(—Because I was hideous.
There was no way... I could just be myself...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ――But... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You called me beautiful.
If it is for you——

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If it pleases you...
Then I...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I don't need any future!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Uggghhhhhh……!!
—GRAAAHHHAAAAAHHHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Squeezing every ounce of breath from my lungs, I scream. Fighting desperately—
Praying my voice reaches her back to push her forward,
as she tries to surpass her past.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Running purely on instinct, exactly as she is... Watching her, one could feel an untouchable 'mystic bloodline' passed down from ancient times—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *pant*... ahh... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My head is spinning. I can't even hear the cheers...
Through this crushing exhaustion where I can barely stand—pure, unadulterated joy wells up inside me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, they're smiling.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
They look so happy...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...
—I'm so glad..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm glad that this was my final race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
—You've won.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Stacking the two together
made it truly complete, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Until it turns translucent.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I understand now.
How you... show your love...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It's maddening.
...Truly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "...And yet, it will soon grow murky."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That dull gray color...
isn't bad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Leaving no regrets.
...You're dedicating everything, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —How merciful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Were you watching over that girl as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Well...
I am not the "Emperor," you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I was merely curious about
a different shape of love, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then.
...I'll go check on those two.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Especially Trainer... Something was clearly off.
They're going to need a helping hand—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Stop that, please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Those two are no longer on this side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Let us leave the two of them alone.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Shh...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Don't speak.
I already understand everything.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You are pleased, aren't you?
Blessing me... are you...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I dedicate this victory to you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"It belongs solely to you.
I... will not take it with me."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So... please.
Don't cry.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —Keep smiling...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Because I love your smile so much.
